“嘭！！！”
无言拼尽了全力调节自己的身体，使倒飞中的身体稳了下来，然后单手撑住地面，一翻身，半伏在地面上，硬是用手中的长剑止住了后退的趋势。
狠狠的喘了几口粗气，看着正在不远处造成这一切，还在对着自己咆哮的似虎似狼的生物体，无言心中大骂。
虎身魔狼：（20级）
再次看了一眼这高达三米的魔兽头上的字样，无言稳了稳心神，站起身来，举起手中的长剑。
原本以为，20级的魔兽也就那样，比起10几级的魔兽，应该相差不太远，自己能够杀死高达19级的魔兽，那么杀死一只高1级的魔兽，应该不是什么难事才对。
可谁曾想到，20级的魔兽跟19级的魔兽根本就是没法比较的存在，两者相差的是天与地的距离，在这一阵纠缠中，无言可以很确定的告诉你们，20级的魔兽，起码比19级的魔兽强上1倍！
要知道，就算是19级的魔兽，也不过是比10级的魔兽强上差不多一半，而这一半，还是从那9级的差距之中拉出来的。
现在，只不过是差了1级，就强大了近乎1倍，这能比吗？
到了现在这个地步，无言也算是知道了，鲁莽真的不对…
不过也能理解，毕竟，无言来到这个世界上，满打满算也才一个月，能够做到这个地步上，已经很不错了。
刚才要不是及时举剑格挡下了对方的一撞，自己就不是倒飞那么简单了！
双手握剑向后托，无言冷静的看着眼前慢慢潜伏过来的虎身魔狼。
在这长达一个月的战斗中，无言也算是初步拥有了一个战士的心态了，至少，面对危机的局面，不会惊慌失措，这对一个月之前看到一条巨蛇就心惊胆战的自己来说，要强上不少了！
虽然不是绝对打不过，经过一个月战斗的洗礼，无言的等级可是提升了不少，再加上自己掌握的‘剑道精通’能力，与20级的魔兽对战的能力还是有的！
嘛…虽然处于劣势是可以肯定的就对了…
竟然已经对上了，那么后悔也没用了，这个时候，只能勇者无敌了！
心中这样想到，无言眼中的寒芒同时一闪，脚步一踩，犹如风一般的速度冲向虎身魔狼。
“吼！！！”看到眼前这个‘小不点’还敢挑衅自己，虎身魔狼当场就怒了，爆吼了一声之后，柔软的身体宛如弹簧一般，猛的弹向冲来的无言。

无言将虎身魔狼的动作视如无睹，仍然我行我素的冲了过来，当与对方的距离相差不到一米时，才突然一跃而起！
几乎是擦着魔狼的后背躲过了它的攻击，无言一扭身躯，一把抓住那不知道是虎尾还是狼尾的尾巴，用力的一扯，将自己扯到对方的后面，手中寒光一闪，草薙剑狠狠的刺入魔狼的…屁股…
随着一阵血光的咋现，魔狼发出一声悲痛的吼叫声，好像是死了爹妈一样的难受，一甩自己的尾巴，将无言抛飞了出去。
顿时，无言的身体，与地面来了一次亲密的接触，跟地面摩擦了近乎两米的距离，无言才一撑地面站了起来。
虽然以自己现在的身体，受到这么大力的摩擦也不过是痛一下而已，连块皮都没有掉，但是无言身上的衣服就没有那么好运了，此时，他那套宅男专用的套装（短袖衣还有大裤衩），已经变成了乞丐的专用套装了。
看着正在上蹿下跳的魔狼，无言嘿嘿一笑，一扯身上的破布条，露出有模有样的上半身来。
自从大量升级以后，无言腰不酸了，腿不疼了，小肚腩也不见了，身体倍儿棒！跟以前的小身板比起来，可要强了不少！
一转手中的长剑，不等魔狼反应过来，无言就来到了它的后面，一斩之下，砍中了魔狼的后背，划出一道巨大的血痕。
狼的弱点无言也是知道的，豆腐腰嘛，一般对付狼的人，都是从它的腰身下手的。
可惜，无言已经忘记了，面前的狼不只是狼，还是拥有虎身的杂种狼…
魔狼怒吼一声，无视背后的伤口，抬起爪子，将还在准备砍第二刀的无言砸飞了出去。
‘嘭’的一声响后，无言就砸在了一颗树干上，嘴角缓缓的流下了鲜血。
虽然在这一个月来，无言也不是没有受伤流血，但是这并不代表他就会习惯，毕竟，无言可是很怕痛的。

"Bang!!!"
Wu Yan tried his best to adjust his body and stabilize his flying body. Then he supported the ground with one hand, turned over, half-lying on the ground, and stopped his retreat with the long sword in his hand.
He took a few deep breaths and looked at the tiger-like wolf-like creature that was causing all this not far away and was still roaring at him, and Wuyan cursed in his heart.
Tiger-body Demonic Wolf: (Level 20)
Taking one more look at the words on the head of the three-meter-tall monster, Wuyan calmed his mind, stood up, and raised the long sword in his hand.
I originally thought that level 20 monsters were just like that. Compared with level 10 monsters, they should not be too far apart. I could kill monsters up to level 19, so it shouldn't be difficult to kill a monster that was one level higher.
But who would have thought that there is no comparison between a level 20 monster and a level 19 monster. The only difference between the two is the distance between heaven and earth. In this entanglement, Wu Yan can tell you with certainty that a level 20 monster is at least twice as powerful as a level 19 monster!
You know, even a level 19 monster is only about half as powerful as a level 10 monster, and this half is still drawn from the 9-level gap.
Now, it's only one level lower, but it's almost twice as powerful. Can this be compared?
At this point, Wu Yan finally understood that it was really wrong to be reckless...
But it's understandable. After all, it's only been a month since Wu Yan came into this world. It's already pretty good to be able to reach this point.
If he hadn't raised his sword in time to block the opponent's collision, he wouldn't have been as simple as flying upside down!
Holding the sword with both hands and holding it back, Wuyan calmly looked at the tiger-body demon wolf slowly lurking in front of him.
In this month-long battle, Wu Yan has initially acquired the mentality of a warrior. At least, he will not panic when facing a crisis situation. This is much better for him who was frightened when he saw a giant snake a month ago!
Although he is not absolutely invincible, after a month of fighting, Wu Yan's level has improved a lot. Coupled with his mastery of swordsmanship, he still has the ability to fight against level 20 monsters!
Well... although it is certain that I am at a disadvantage...
They have already faced each other, so there is no point in regretting it. At this time, only the brave can be invincible!
With this thought in his mind, the cold light in Wu Yan's eyes flashed at the same time, and he stepped on his feet and rushed towards the tiger-bodied demon wolf as fast as the wind.
"Roar!!!" Seeing that the 'little one' in front of him dared to challenge himself, the tiger-bodied demon wolf became angry on the spot. After roaring loudly, its soft body was like a spring, and it jumped towards Wu Yan who was rushing towards him.
Wu Yan turned a blind eye to the movements of the tiger-bodied demon wolf, and still rushed over on his own terms. When the distance between him and the opponent was less than one meter, he suddenly jumped up!
Almost wiping the demon wolf's back to avoid its attack, Wu Yan twisted his body, grabbed the tail of a tiger or a wolf, and pulled hard, pulling himself to the opponent's back. A cold light flashed in his hand, and the Kusanagi sword pierced the demon wolf's... butt...
As a burst of blood appeared, the demon wolf let out a mournful roar, feeling as if his parents had died. He flicked his tail and threw Wu Yan away.
Suddenly, Wu Yan's body came into close contact with the ground, rubbing against the ground for nearly two meters, before Wu Yan stood up with his support on the ground.
Although with his current body, receiving such a strong friction was only a little painful, and not even a piece of skin fell off, but the clothes on Wu Yan were not so lucky. At this time, his otaku-style clothesThe suit he used (short-sleeved shirt and large pants) has become a beggar's exclusive suit.
Looking at the demon wolf jumping up and down, Wu Yan chuckled and pulled the rag strips on his body, revealing his decent upper body.
Since a large number of upgrades, Wuyan’s waist is no longer sore, his legs are no longer painful, his belly is gone, and his body feels great! Compared with the small body before, it is much stronger!
Turning the long sword in his hand, Wu Yan came behind the demon wolf without waiting for it to react. With one slash, he hit the demon wolf's back, leaving a huge bloody mark.
Wu Yan also knew the weakness of the wolf. It was like a tofu waist. People who usually deal with wolves would start from its waist.
Unfortunately, Wu Yan has forgotten that the wolf in front of him is not just a wolf, but a hybrid wolf with the body of a tiger...
The demon wolf roared angrily, ignored the wounds on his back, raised his claws, and knocked Wu Yan away, who was still preparing for the second blow.
After a 'bang' sound, Wuyan hit a tree trunk, and blood slowly flowed from the corner of his mouth.
Although Wu Yan has not been injured and bleeding in the past month, this does not mean that he will get used to it. After all, Wu Yan is very afraid of pain.
